2206. Finding Row Sums and Column Sums of a Matrix

80

Hard

Problem Statement
Read a matrix of size M x N and print the sum of each row and the sum of each column, using nested loops and two helper arrays.

Description
Read two integers M and N representing the number of rows and columns, and then read M x N integers into a two-dimensional array. Use two one-dimensional arrays, rowSum and colSum, to hold the sum of every row and every column, and set all their values to 0 before using them. Use nested loops to add each element matrix[i][j] to both rowSum[i] and colSum[j]. Print the M row sums separated by spaces on the first line, and the N column sums separated by spaces on the second line.
input_spec: Two integers M and N, followed by M x N integers given row by row.
output_spec: Print the row sums on the first line and the column sums on the second line, each separated by spaces.
